items.title: t3code adds 3,100 stars in a day to run every agent from one app
items.summary:
t3code is an agent control surface that drives claude code, codex, cursor, grok build and opencode from one mobile, web or desktop app.
it added about 3,100 stars today, the biggest gain on github trending, and holds 38,390 stars in total at #4 on github and trendshift.

items.title: claude-mem holds #1 on trending as its run cools to about 1,500 stars today
items.summary:
claude-mem gives coding agents persistent memory by compressing every session and injecting the useful context back into later ones.
it stayed #1 on github trending with about 1,500 stars today and 109,531 total, and sits #7 on trendshift.

items.title: ai-engineering-hub pulls 1,191 stars for runnable llm and agent tutorials
items.summary:
ai-engineering-hub collects in-depth tutorials on llms, rag pipelines and real agent applications, mostly as notebooks you can run.
it added 1,191 stars today to reach 40,401 and sits #15 on github trending and #17 on trendshift.

items.title: hex adds 1,179 stars for dictation that never leaves the machine
items.summary:
hex is local voice dictation for mac, windows and linux, with speech recognition running on the device instead of a cloud service.
it added 1,179 stars today for 3,439 total and sits #12 on github trending, with the repo pushed this morning.

items.title: claude-code-game-studios adds about 970 stars for a 49-agent studio
items.summary:
the repo turns claude code into a game studio with 49 agents and 72 workflow skills wired into one coordination system.
it added about 970 stars today and holds 32,468 total at #8 on github trending and #22 on trendshift.

items.title: openmausbot adds about 920 stars for a self-hosted bot team
items.summary:
openmausbot is an open-source grok bot alternative that gives every bot its own virtual machine, browser and files.
it added about 920 stars today to reach 10,694 and held #5 on github trending, with the repo pushed minutes before this build.

items.title: lightpanda adds about 825 stars for an ai-first headless browser
items.summary:
lightpanda is a headless browser built for ai agents and automation, with its own engine rather than a chromium wrapper.
it added about 825 stars today, passed 40,000 total, and sits #2 on github trending and #16 on trendshift.

items.title: doha talks run a third day as qatar works on $6bn in iranian assets
items.summary:
indirect us-iran talks in doha went into a third day with qatar trying to release more than $6bn in frozen iranian assets in a deal that could reopen hormuz.
iran has agreed to compress the sequence from seven days to two, while araghchi skipped the talks for a trip to turkmenistan on monday.
items.change: the mediation moved from a two-day plan on paper to a third day of talks focused on releasing $6bn, with rubio saying trump has not decided on new strikes.

items.title: rubio says trump wants to end the iran war peacefully as both sides prepare
items.summary:
rubio said trump has not made a decision on new strikes and would prefer to resolve the war diplomatically rather than with force.
khamenei ordered an immediate, impactful and geographically unrestricted response to any attack and told the military to map all us and israeli assets.
items.change: rubio put the white house's preference for diplomacy on the record a day after khamenei widened the target list beyond the region.

items.title: irgc says two tankers exploded on mines in hormuz, one a burning supertanker
items.summary:
an irgc spokesperson said two oil tankers on an unauthorized route hit mines in the strait, with one supertanker engulfed in flames.
ukmto had already logged a tanker hit by an unknown projectile on sunday, and the attacks continue while doha mediates a reopening.
items.change: the irgc moved from reporting an unexplained blast to naming mines and two tankers, one of them a supertanker.

items.title: ukmto logs a tanker hit twice off ras al-khafji, widening the risk beyond hormuz
items.summary:
a tanker heading southeast through the gulf was struck twice on its port side 72 nautical miles east of saudi arabia's ras al-khafji, ukmto said.
the crew was accounted for and no environmental damage was reported, but it is the second vessel hit near the strait in a day.
items.change: a new strike landed on the saudi side of the gulf, widening the risk beyond the strait itself.

items.title: saudi-led coalition strikes houthi 'vital resources' as hodeidah port is hit
items.summary:
the saudi-led coalition said it ran an operation to neutralize vital houthi resources, while houthi media reported strikes on hodeidah port.
xinhua reported the coalition announcement without a damage toll, and houthi media said the port was hit.
items.change: the coalition announced a fresh operation against houthi logistics and hit hodeidah, a day after houthi media renewed threats on saudi oil and aviation.

items.title: israel's election chief says the result stands after likud's fraud claims
items.summary:
elections committee head noam sohlberg said even substantiated irregularities would not undermine the result, appearing alongside the shin bet chief.
likud claimed arab-led parties stole the vote with qatari money, qatar denied it, and bennett's party has now backed eisenkot for prime minister.
items.change: the committee and shin bet went public to defend the count after likud's claim, while the blocs stay at 53-48 with arab parties on 19.

items.title: syria weighs joining saudi arabia's mutual defence pact, the times reports
items.summary:
damascus is considering joining saudi arabia's mutual defence pact as the yemen war keeps pulling in regional capitals, according to the new york times.
the report lands as the saudi-led coalition runs a new operation against houthi resources and gulf states brace for a wider iran war.
items.change: a new report puts syria in talks to join the saudi-led security arrangement.

items.title: un chief condemns the death of a staff member in houthi detention
items.summary:
antonio guterres condemned the death of a un staff member held by the houthis in yemen, according to anadolu agency.
the staffer was mohammad el-shami of the un human rights office, whose death the un confirmed this weekend and wants investigated.
items.change: the un secretary-general personally condemned the death a day after the agency confirmed it and demanded an investigation.

Netanyahu accuses Israel's Arab parties of 'stealing the vote'

items.title: s&p 500 falls 1.8% and the nasdaq 2.9% to end a rough october
items.summary:
the s&p 500 closed at 7,580.07 on friday, down 1.82% for its worst day since june, and the nasdaq composite fell 2.86% to 25,437.
the dow lost 1.09% to 51,770, the vix rose 12.9% to 19.42, and october finished with the nasdaq down 5.3%.

items.title: futures point up after the selloff with the midterms a day away
items.summary:
s&p futures were up 0.43% and nasdaq futures up 0.86% at 06:20 riyadh, recovering part of friday's drop.
the midterm elections are on tuesday, with control of congress and the next decision on iran on the same calendar.

items.title: brent drops about 3% to $110 as traders look past the tanker attacks
items.summary:
brent for january was $110.17 and wti $100.93 early monday, both down roughly 3% from friday despite the fresh attacks in hormuz.
the drop came even as the irgc reported two tankers on fire, with the december brent contract having settled at $117.64 on friday.

items.title: apple and palantir report after the close to start a heavy earnings week
items.summary:
apple, palantir, vertex and on semiconductor report after the us close on monday, with marriott, estee lauder and tower semiconductor before the open.
consensus is $1.98 a share for apple and $0.33 for palantir, and amd follows on tuesday with the stock already down 11% on friday.

items.title: amd falls 10.9% as intel's pc warning hits chips before earnings
items.summary:
amd closed at $504.80 on friday, down 10.9%, after intel's results flagged a pc slump and supply limits across the chip sector.
amd reports on tuesday, while tower semiconductor fell 11.4% ahead of its own results today.

items.title: ism manufacturing is the macro test at 18:00 riyadh before payrolls friday
items.summary:
economists expect the ism manufacturing index at 54.6 for october, a touch above september's 54.5, with construction spending also due.
goolsbee speaks later, then jolts on tuesday, adp on wednesday and the october payrolls report on friday.
items.change: the week's data run starts with ism manufacturing today and ends with payrolls on friday, with the midterms in between.

items.title: binance sees $3.64bn of net outflows as withdrawals resume after the hack
items.summary:
binance recorded $3.64bn in net outflows after reopening withdrawals following the $6.3bn hack, according to cnbc.
bitcoin was around $78,500 early monday, up about 1% from friday, while the fbi blames north korea for the theft.
items.change: withdrawals are open again, but the exchange has now lost $3.64bn in net outflows since the hack.

items.title: investors dust off 'big short' trades as the ai selloff deepens
items.summary:
the jerusalem post reports investors are turning to big-short style hedges as ai stocks tumble and fears of a market crash build.
the nasdaq lost 5.3% in october, and palantir and amd are both down sharply into their earnings this week.

items.title: arsenal win at anfield for the first time since 2012 and leave liverpool fifth
items.summary:
kai havertz tapped in declan rice's low cross on 16 minutes after alisson's poor pass out put liverpool behind at anfield.
arsenal go top on 24 points, liverpool stay fifth and nine points back after a second league defeat of the season.

items.title: iraola says it was '100% a penalty' and will tell isak to go down
items.summary:
liverpool were denied a spot kick when jurrien timber pulled alexander isak's shirt, and var did not intervene.
iraola called it 100% a penalty and said he will tell alex to go to ground in future, while van dijk asked what the cameras are for.

items.title: wirtz hits the bar but bbc says he must do more in the big games
items.summary:
wirtz curled a free kick against the bar and mac allister headed a clear chance over as liverpool failed to score at home.
bbc gave alisson a 4 for the error and said a player on wirtz's price tag has to do more, with barcola the pick on 7.

items.title: nyoni's first league start leaves gravenberch watching from the bench
items.summary:
trey nyoni, 19, started his first premier league game ahead of ryan gravenberch, who had been expected to partner mac allister.
carragher called it a 'mighty blow' to gravenberch's confidence, and szoboszlai and munoz were fit enough for the bench.

items.title: liverpool go to fenerbahce on wednesday with little time to reset
items.summary:
liverpool play fenerbahce away in the champions league league stage on wednesday, kicking off at 20:45 riyadh.
it starts a run of two away games before manchester united visit anfield on 22 november.

items.title: crystal palace away on sunday, then manchester united at anfield
items.summary:
liverpool go to crystal palace on sunday at 17:00 riyadh, then host manchester united on 22 november at 19:30.
everton away follows on 29 november, with club brugge away in europe on 25 november.

items.title: mourinho says trent has accepted rotation as the exit talk cools
items.summary:
jose mourinho said trent alexander-arnold and denzel dumfries accepted his rotation calls and that the decision was not aimed at anyone.
trent started the 3-0 win at racing santander on sunday after starting only four of his seven appearances this season.
items.change: mourinho addressed the exit talk directly and said trent has taken the rotation without complaint.

items.title: bournemouth at home in the carabao cup quarter-finals
items.summary:
liverpool will host bournemouth in the carabao cup quarter-finals after beating chelsea in the previous round.
the tie is liverpool's next cup fixture after the premier league run, with the quarter-final date not yet on the fixture list.
